digest.component_or_area: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and operation configuration composition
propositions: ADR 0098 must document the approved decision that Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration separately from provider-auth and runtime bindings at application boundaries
The ADR must cite primary-source research for Pydantic, AWS, Git, Jira, and Rebar probes to support all external-dependency behavior claims
ADR 0098 must narrow ADR 0049 only at the per-job retrieval and composition seam while explicitly preserving its unaffected decisions on protocol, trust roots, producer, and storage

The ADR must record concrete decisions on operation-snapshot precedence, provider-native pre-client auth injection, static carriers, subprocess environment rules, restart/redeploy rotation, and fail-closed auth

The draft must identify and resolve unresolved external claims, internal inconsistencies, missing constraints, and conflicts with ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0049, 0050, 0059, and 0083 in a numbered critique
Documentation artifacts including ADR 0098, docs/adr/README.md, .numbers/0098, and docs/architecture.md must pass generated checks and be recorded as landed on origin/main with Gerrit merge evidence
